info.title: My Barber API
info.description:
Barber booking API built with Node.js and TypeScript.

**Schemas:** `components.schemas` mirrors TypeScript types in `models/` (e.g. `BookingStatus`, `BookingContract` ↔ `models/booking.ts`; barber approval ↔ `models/barber.ts`). Enumerations are OpenAPI `enum`s; request/response bodies use `$ref` where noted.

bearerAuth.description: Barber/client JWT from login endpoints, or a Firebase Auth ID token with custom claim admin:true / role:admin for Admin routes. Dev/bootstrap: JWT whose user `id` is in ADMIN_UID_ALLOWLIST.

description.example: Barber booking API built with Node.js and TypeScript

BookingStatus.description: Lifecycle state of a booking (models/booking.ts BookingStatus).

BookingContract.description: Snake_case booking payload returned by mobile-facing endpoints (models/booking.ts BookingContract).

BookingCalendarRow.description: Summary row for barber/day calendar lists (BookingDetails in services).

ClientBookingHistoryData.description: Full-client booking timeline (all barbers). Use GET /client/booking-history; GET /client/bookings stays per-barber.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; pass as query param `cursor`.

barber.description: Barber profile with approval_status, approval_message (snake_case); aligns with models/barber Barber minus password.

OpenApiSpecRoot.description: Full OpenAPI 3 document (same JSON as GET /docs.json). Schema is recursive; clients may treat as arbitrary JSON.

BarberResponse.description: Public barber profile (models/barber.ts BarberResponse; no password field).
